tools.name: btc_free_preview
tools.description: Free, instant, no payment: the current rounded BTC spot and futures index, basis and how many venues are fresh. Use this first for 'what is BTC doing right now?'. It has no history, per-venue detail or derivatives depth: for those, pick a product with btc_list_products and see its output with btc_fr

tools.name: btc_list_products
tools.description: Free. Every AgentReeve product with its price in USD (paid per call in USDC on Base via x402), what it returns, whether it is available now and its inputs. Use this to choose a product for a question. It does not return market data: use btc_free_sample to see a product's real output, and btc_product
